'''Sarlacc and Loaded Cantina''' was a cantina on [[Molavar/Legends|Molavar]] during the [[Galactic War]]. It was reputed to be "the end of the line", "even by Outer Rim standards". [[Seamus Kaldo]] and his bodyguard [[Vhonu]] once met the infamous smuggler [[Nico Okarr]] at this cantina.
